subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed only as per-turn untrusted structured context, made available to plugin hooks, or persisted as session metadata for later Conversions API use?
rationale: The extraction is bounded, but the requested value is an advertising click identifier and the issue explicitly asks for agent/session exposure, so automation should not choose the visibility and retention boundary.

options.title: Per-turn untrusted context only
options.body: Extract `ctwaClid` and related non-secret ad fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing fenced untrusted structured-context prompt path without durable persistence.

options.title: Plugin-hook attribution payload
options.body: Define a typed WhatsApp attribution payload for opted-in plugin hooks so a Conversions API plugin can consume the click ID without putting it into every agent prompt.

options.title: Persist session attribution
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session state only after maintainers define explicit retention, redaction, and access rules.

recommendation.title: Per-turn untrusted context only
recommendation.body: Extract `ctwaClid` and related non-secret ad fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing fenced untrusted structured-context prompt path without durable persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the newest current-main WhatsApp extraction and monitor code involved in the prompt/session boundary decision.
